name: Bypass of a required layer that has no package (known miss)
source: Layer bypass with a required_layer the program does not have: the handler reaches the repository and the policy requires a service layer, but no package sits under the service prefix. Known miss, by design: pkg/projectmodel/go_layer_bypass.go treats a required layer with no call-graph node as ambiguous and reports nothing, so that a mistyped prefix cannot remove nothing and flag everything
note: The scan is not silent about it, but it does not name the cause. With a required_layer whose prefix matches no package, coach codesignal --baseline reports complete=false for the go_model_build phase, the diagnostics project_coverage_incomplete, project_layer_bypass_coverage_incomplete ('absence of a witness for a source/sink pair in this run does not mean no bypass exists') and project_lifecycle_indeterminate, the text verdict 'the analysis is incomplete: project analysis did not complete', and --fail-on-incomplete-coverage exits 3; the default exit is 0 and no finding is reported. Nothing says that the required layer matched no package. Filed as lousy-agents/coach#877 (name the cause when required_layer matches no package). The bad variant's scan is therefore expected to be incomplete, which this fixture declares with expect_incomplete.
